item.title: Allied Gold begins wet commissioning at Kurmuk mine
item.description: The Canadian company expects to pour its first gold within days from the Benishangul-Gumuz Regional State operation.

item.title: Ethiopian PM trains cabinet in military drills
item.description: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed says armed forces discipline builds stronger leaders and advances national development.

item.title: Drone strikes kill 25 civilians in Ethiopia
item.description: Witnesses report multiple strikes hit northern regions since Thursday, with children among the victims in Amhara.
